name: mock-server
description: /mock starts a fake API server from your OpenAPI spec so you can build the frontend before the backend.

port.title: Port
port.description: The port /mock listens on when you do not name one.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: auto: Prism when the project has @stoplight/prism-cli installed, else the built-in mock (needs Node.js). prism: always Prism (via npx when not installed). builtin: always the built-in mock.
